rule.name: ConstantLookupInLoop
rule.message: This reflective lookup finds the same class, method, field or constructor on every pass of this loop or callback: its arguments are constants and nothing in the loop changes what it finds. Look it up once before the loop (or in a static final field) and reuse the result.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $bodies := (//ForeachStatement/*[last()] | //ForStatement/*[last()] | //WhileStatement/*[last()] | //DoStatement/*[1] | //LambdaExpression[parent::ArgumentList/parent::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('forEach', 'forEachOrdered', 'forEachRemaining', 'map', 'flatMap', 'filter', 'peek', 'anyMatch', 'allMatch', 'noneMatch', 'mapToObj', 'mapToInt', 'mapToLong')][*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.stream.BaseStream') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Iterable') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Iterator')]]]/*[last()]), $calls := $bodies//MethodCall [ancestor::*[self::ForeachStatement or self::ForStatement or self::WhileStatement or self::DoStatement or self::LambdaExpression][1] [not(self::LambdaExpression) or exists(*[last()] intersect $bodies)] [not(self::ForeachStatement/*[2][self::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('of', 'asList')] or self::ArrayAllocation])]] return $calls[@MethodName = ('getMethod', 'getDeclaredMethod', 'getField', 'getDeclaredField', 'getConstructor', 'getDeclaredConstructor')] [*[1][self::ClassLiteral]] [empty(ArgumentList/*[not(self::StringLiteral or self::ClassLiteral)])] | $calls[@MethodName = 'forName'][*[1][self::TypeExpression][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Class')]] [ArgumentList/@Size = 1][ArgumentList/*[1][self::StringLiteral]]
